state.interrupted: picking up where it left off

detail.signedOut: Sign in, and Intentic makes one sandbox on this computer for the folders you work on with an agent.

needsDocker.notInstalled: It runs in Docker, which isn't on this computer. Install Docker Desktop, and Intentic sets the sandbox up once it runs.
needsDocker.notRunning: It runs in Docker, which isn't running. Start it, and Intentic carries on by itself.
needsDocker.notAllowed: Docker is running and turns this account away. Add your account to Docker's group (docker-users on Windows), then sign out and back in.

detail.creating: Intentic is setting it up in the background. Your folders go into it as soon as it's ready.
detail.interrupted: Intentic closed while it was being set up, so it's picking up where it left off.
detail.waiting: This computer needs a few things before it can run a sandbox.
detail.ready: The folders you work on with an agent go into it, each in a folder of its own.
detail.stopped: It's on this computer and not running. Start it to work on your folders with an agent.
detail.failed: Its setup stopped. The log says what it was doing.
detail.gone: It's no longer on your account or on this computer. Make a new one, and your folders go into it.
